_comment: ARGUS Data Alert Thresholds — edit this file to adjust alert rules

_types.absolute: compare latest value directly against threshold
_types.yoy: compare year-over-year % change (for CPI Index etc.)

_data_formats.us_cpi: CPI Index ~327, use type=yoy or type=change
_data_formats.ca_policy_rate: rate % e.g. 2.25, use type=absolute or change
_data_formats.us_sofr: rate % e.g. 3.65, use type=absolute or change
_data_formats.ca_usdcad: FX rate e.g. 1.3916, use type=absolute or change
_data_formats.us_treasury_auctions: offering_amt in USD e.g. 22000000000, use type=change

rules.name: US CPI Month-over-Month Rise
rules.description: US CPI index rose more than 0.3% MoM — inflation pressure building

rules.name: US CPI Rapid Acceleration
